source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the temperate deciduous forest (PDF 241-246).

blocks.text: Yeh jangalat nam pahari ilaqon mein ugte hain jahan wazeh mausam hain, jin mein thandi sardi bhi hai jab darakht patte gira dete hain (deciduous).

blocks.alt: Temperate deciduous jangal ka saada labelled manzar aur saath maloomat ka card.
blocks.caption: temperate deciduous jangal: labelled khaaka aur maloomat ka card (asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Jangal se dhaki pahari dhalaan, chaure patton aur conifer darakhton aur nale ke saath. Card mein jagah (Shogran, Neelam Valley, Murree, Kaghan), aab-o-hawa (4 se 30 C, 750-1500 mm barish) aur humus bhari surmai bhoori mitti, paude (yew, blue pine, deodar, Berberis lyceum), janwar (rhesus bandar, kaala reechh, leopard cat, bheriye, parinde) aur haalat (lakri ki sanat aur kheti se kharab).
